item.title: MiCA enforcement: 83% of EU crypto firms missed the July 1 CASP deadline and now lack legal basis to serve clients across the bloc.
U.S. CLARITY Act faces Senate delay ahead of the August 10 recess deadline, leaving crypto market structure legislation unresolved.
North Korea-linked actors stole $643 million in H1 2026, representing 66% of the $972 million lost to crypto hacks in 207 incidents.
A $70 million crypto wallet hack emerged in the first week of August 2026, adding to a record year of digital asset theft.
Western Union selected Solana as the blockchain for a stablecoin settlement platform serving more than 150 million customers.
Fidelity, State Street, and Invesco each launched GENIUS Act-compliant stablecoin reserve funds in June 2026.
Crypto platforms lost $755 million across 83 hacks in Q2 2026, the highest number of incidents recorded in a single quarter.
Citigroup plans to launch institutional crypto custody services in 2026 after approximately three years of internal development.
Deutsche Bank plans to launch a digital asset custody service in 2026 in partnership with Bitpanda's technology subsidiary.
The EU's Transfer of Funds Regulation dropped the travel rule reporting threshold to zero for all crypto-asset transfers.
UK FCA will open crypto firm licensing in September 2026 under a comprehensive digital asset regulatory framework.
Minnesota authorized state-chartered banks and credit unions to offer Bitcoin and digital asset custody starting August 2026.
Cecabank, a Spanish wholesale custodian with 400 billion euros in AUM, activated crypto custody services through a partnership with Bit2Me.
BlackRock deployed over $600 million on-chain through tokenization platform Securitize, expanding its real-world asset program.
XRP exchange-traded funds accumulated $1.48 billion in cumulative inflows in the eight months since their November 2025 U.S. launch.
